items.html: Also with regard to the third interpretation there is a difficulty from all places, for on weekdays all the Mochin are only in the NHY of Yeshsut and Tevuna, and even on a festival they are in Tevuna, in its HGT; but in Aba and Ima they are only on the Sabbath and on the night of Passover, as mentioned there in its place. And from there it is understood explicitly that all these Mochin of internality are from Yeshsut and Tevuna themselves, as mentioned elsewhere. The upshot of all this is that the first interpretation is true; therefore we shall expand its explanation well, in a brief manner, with God's help.
